ELIGE TU ANIMALITO
\n
Cada niño toca un animal libre al terminar su trabajo. Los 20 permanecen visibles. El borde azul señala a quienes tienen prioridad para salir.
\n
\n
\n
Sin turno. Elige animalitos y gira la ruleta.
\n
\n
\n
Azul: prioridadAmarillo: juega ahoraVerde: finalizado
\n
La ruleta prioriza primero a quienes todavía no han jugado y después a quienes llevan menos turnos.
\n
\n
\n\n
\n
LA RULETA ELIGE
\n

¿Quién juega ahora?

\n
Prioridad
Elige varios animalitos para empezar.
\n
\n
\n \n
\n
PreparadosPrimero juegan quienes todavía no han participado.
\n
\n \n \n
\n
\n
\n
\n\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
Niveles y actividad
\n
La ruleta debe elegir primero a un jugador.
\n
\n
Sin jugador
\n
\n
\n
\n

\n

\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n"}; const frame=document.getElementById('appFrame'); const routeTitle=document.getElementById('routeTitle'); const fsBtn=document.getElementById('globalFullscreen'); function normalizePath(path){ if(!path) return '/'; path=path.split('?')[0].split('#')[0]; if(path!=='/' && !path.endsWith('/')) path+='/'; return ROUTES[path] ? path : '/'; } function siteRootURL(){ const url=new URL(location.href); let path=url.pathname; const routeSuffixes=["/a/trazo/","/e/trazo/","/i/trazo/","/o/trazo/","/u/trazo/","/d/centro/","/d/mision/","/d/cuento/","/d/trazo/","/m/centro/","/m/mision/","/s/centro/","/s/mision/","/s/cuento/","/l/centro/","/l/mision/","/l/trazo/","/a/","/e/","/i/","/o/","/u/","/d/","/m/","/s/","/l/"]; for(const suffix of routeSuffixes){ if(path.endsWith(suffix)){ path=path.slice(0,-suffix.length+1); return url.origin+path; } } if(!path.endsWith('/')){ path=path.substring(0,path.lastIndexOf('/')+1); } return url.origin+path; } function initialRoute(){ const path=location.pathname; const candidates=["/a/trazo/","/e/trazo/","/i/trazo/","/o/trazo/","/u/trazo/","/d/centro/","/d/mision/","/d/cuento/","/d/trazo/","/m/centro/","/m/mision/","/s/centro/","/s/mision/","/s/cuento/","/l/centro/","/l/mision/","/l/trazo/","/a/","/e/","/i/","/o/","/u/","/d/","/m/","/s/","/l/"]; for(const route of candidates){ if(path.endsWith(route)) return route; } return '/'; } function internalBaseFromSrc(src){ const clean=src.split('?')[0].split('#')[0].replace(/^\/+/, ''); const full=new URL(clean,siteRootURL()).href; return full.substring(0,full.lastIndexOf('/')+1); } function rewriteLocalRootAssets(doc){ const root=siteRootURL(); doc.querySelectorAll('[src],[href],[poster]').forEach(el=>{ for(const attr of ['src','href','poster']){ if(!el.hasAttribute(attr)) continue; const value=el.getAttribute(attr); if(value && value.startsWith('/assets/')){ el.setAttribute(attr,new URL(value.slice(1),root).href); } } }); doc.querySelectorAll('style').forEach(style=>{ style.textContent=style.textContent .replace(/url\(\s*'\/assets\//g,`url('${root}assets/`) .replace(/url\(\s*"\/assets\//g,`url("${root}assets/`) .replace(/url\(\s*\/assets\//g,`url(${root}assets/`); }); } function prepareInternalDocument(rawHtml, src){ const parser=new DOMParser(); const doc=parser.parseFromString(rawHtml,'text/html'); // Hace que assets relativos de cada actividad apunten a su carpeta real local. const base=doc.createElement('base'); base.href=internalBaseFromSrc(src); doc.head.prepend(base); rewriteLocalRootAssets(doc); // Único fullscreen: lo controla la barra superior. const fsStyle=doc.createElement('style'); fsStyle.textContent=` #fullscreenBtn, [data-page-fullscreen], .s-page-fullscreen, .cuento-fullscreen{ display:none!important; } `; doc.head.appendChild(fsStyle); return '\n'+doc.documentElement.outerHTML; } function loadRoute(path){ path=normalizePath(path); const route=ROUTES[path]; const raw=EMBEDDED_DOCS[path]; routeTitle.textContent=route.title; document.title=route.title; if(route && route.direct){ frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc'); const clean=route.src.replace(/^\\/+/, ''); frame.src=new URL(clean,siteRootURL()).href; return; } if(!raw){ frame.srcdoc=` No se pudo cargar esta actividad. `; return; } frame.removeAttribute('src'); frame.srcdoc=prepareInternalDocument(raw,route.src); } window.addEventListener('message',(ev)=>{ if(ev.source!==frame.contentWindow) return; const data=ev.data||{}; if(data.type!=='zurron:navigate') return; if(typeof data.path!=='string') return; loadRoute(data.path); }); async function toggleFullscreen(){ try{ if(!document.fullscreenElement){ await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen(); }else{ await document.exitFullscreen(); } }catch(e){} } function updateFullscreen(){ const active=!!document.fullscreenElement; fsBtn.textContent=active?'SALIR DE PANTALLA COMPLETA':'PANTALLA COMPLETA'; fsBtn.classList.toggle('active',active); } fsBtn.addEventListener('click',toggleFullscreen); document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',updateFullscreen); loadRoute(initialRoute()); updateFullscreen();
